title: Daniel in the Lions' Den

questions.question: How many satraps did Darius set over the kingdom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:1 (ESV): "It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom 120 satraps,"

questions.question: Why did the other high officials and satraps seek to find a ground for complaint against Daniel?
options: Because he was distinguished above them and the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: Because he was distinguished above them and the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:3 (ESV): "Then this Daniel became distinguished above all the other high officials... and the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom."

questions.question: What decree did the officials convince the king to sign?
options: That whoever makes petition to any god or man for 30 days, except to the king, shall be cast into the den of lions
That no one can eat meat
That everyone must worship the sun
questions.correctAnswer: That whoever makes petition to any god or man for 30 days, except to the king, shall be cast into the den of lions
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:7 (ESV): "whoever makes petition to any god or man for thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions."

questions.question: What did Daniel do when he knew the document had been signed?
options: He went to his house and prayed three times a day as he had done previously
questions.correctAnswer: He went to his house and prayed three times a day as he had done previously
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:10 (ESV): "When Daniel knew that the document had been signed, he went to his house... and he knelt upon his knees three times a day and prayed"

questions.question: Who did the king say would deliver Daniel from the lions?
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:16 (ESV): "The king declared to Daniel, 'May your God, whom you serve continually, deliver you!'"

questions.question: How was the mouth of the den sealed?
options: With a stone and the king's signet
questions.correctAnswer: With a stone and the king's signet
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:17 (ESV): "And a stone was brought and laid on the mouth of the den, and the king sealed it with his own signet"

questions.question: How did the king spend the night while Daniel was in the den?
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:18 (ESV): "Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting; no diversions were brought to him, and sleep fled from him."

questions.question: What did Daniel say God had done to save him?
options: Sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths
questions.correctAnswer: Sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:22 (ESV): "My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths, and they have not harmed me,"

questions.question: What happened to the men who had maliciously accused Daniel?
options: They were cast into the den of lions with their children and wives
questions.correctAnswer: They were cast into the den of lions with their children and wives
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:24 (ESV): "And the king commanded, and those men who had maliciously accused Daniel were brought and cast into the den of lions--they, their children, and their wives."

questions.question: What decree did King Darius make after Daniel's deliverance?
options: That in all his dominion people are to tremble and fear before the God of Daniel
questions.correctAnswer: That in all his dominion people are to tremble and fear before the God of Daniel
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:26 (ESV): "I make a decree, that in all my royal dominion people are to tremble and fear before the God of Daniel,"

questions.question: Could the king change the decree once it was signed?
options: No, according to the law of the Medes and Persians
Yes, if he paid a fine
questions.correctAnswer: No, according to the law of the Medes and Persians
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:12 (ESV): "The thing stands fast, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be revoked."

questions.question: Which direction did Daniel face when he prayed?
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:10 (ESV): "where he had windows in his upper chamber open toward Jerusalem."

questions.question: What did the men say they would NOT find against Daniel?
options: Any ground for complaint unless it was in connection with the law of his God
questions.correctAnswer: Any ground for complaint unless it was in connection with the law of his God
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:5 (ESV): "We shall not find any ground for complaint against this Daniel unless we find it in connection with the law of his God."

questions.question: When did the lions overpower the accusers?
options: Before they reached the bottom of the den
questions.correctAnswer: Before they reached the bottom of the den
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:24 (ESV): "And before they reached the bottom of the den, the lions overpowered them and broke all their bones in pieces."

questions.question: Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:28 (ESV): "So this Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian."

key_verse_text: My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths, and they have not harmed me, because I was found blameless before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.
